projects.description: CheckMate is an end-to-end attendance management system that enables secure self-marking through Wi-Fi range verification, device binding, and biometric authentication. It reduces attendance marking time by up to 90% while minimizing proxy attendance and improving attendance accuracy.

QwickHub is an end-to-end ERP platform for startups, managing projects from initiation through client delivery and post-service support with role-based access control (RBAC). It also provides client collaboration, HR management, leave tracking, reporting, and asset management—all on a single platform.

E-Commerce Backend is a scalable backend platform built for the aquarium industry, supporting modern e-commerce features such as product and category management, secure authentication, order processing, and efficient data management.
Frontend built for an aquarium e-commerce application.
